recognize_zh: 結腸黏膜固有層被小型、成熟外觀的淋巴球瀰漫性擴張，把腺窩撐開但腺窩結構大致保留、無明顯破壞或上皮浸潤；免疫染色為 CD3+、CD8+、CD4−、CD5 喪失、TIA-1+、Granzyme B−，MIB-1 極低，PCR 顯示 TCR 單株重排，符合胃腸道惰性 T 細胞淋巴增生性疾病（indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract）。
features: Dense, monotonous infiltrate of small lymphocytes expanding the lamina propria and separating crypts, with largely preserved crypt architecture
Small cells with slightly irregular, dense nuclei, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm; no significant cytologic atypia or large cells
No destructive lymphoepithelial lesions or prominent epitheliotropism; scattered eosinophils and plasma cells in the background
IHC: CD3+, CD2+, CD7+, CD5 largely lost, CD8+, CD4-, TCR-beta F1+, TIA-1+, granzyme B-, CD56-, CD20 only scattered B cells
MIB-1 (Ki-67) very low in the lymphoid infiltrate (positive mainly in crypt epithelium)
PCR: clonal TCR beta and TCR gamma rearrangements with polyclonal IGH; endoscopy shows multiple small mucosal polyps
describe_en: Endoscopic colonic biopsies show fragments of mucosa in which the lamina propria is diffusely expanded by a dense, monotonous infiltrate of small lymphocytes that separates but does not destroy the crypts. The lymphocytes have small, slightly irregular dense nuclei, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant cytoplasm, admixed with occasional eosinophils and plasma cells; there is no significant epitheliotropism, necrosis or large-cell component. Immunohistochemistry shows the infiltrate to be CD3+, CD2+, CD7+, CD8+, TCR-beta F1+ and TIA-1+ with loss of CD5 and negativity for CD4, CD56 and granzyme B, with only scattered CD20+ B cells and a very low MIB-1 proliferation index. PCR studies demonstrate clonal TCR beta and gamma gene rearrangements with a polyclonal IGH pattern. In the setting of multiple small polyps and a protracted course without progression, findings are consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract (indolent T-cell lymphoma of the GI tract, WHO 5th edition).

ddx.vs: MEITL shows marked epitheliotropism by medium-sized monomorphic cells that are typically CD8+, CD56+, often MATK+ with a high Ki-67, unlike the non-epitheliotropic CD56-negative, low-proliferation infiltrate here.
EATL presents with ulcerating, destructive masses of medium-to-large pleomorphic cells with necrosis, frequent CD30 expression and a high proliferation index in the setting of celiac disease.

Reactive colitis has a mixed CD4/CD8 infiltrate with plasma cell-rich lamina propria, crypt distortion or cryptitis, preserved CD5 and polyclonal TCR, whereas this infiltrate is monotonous CD8+, CD5-lost and clonal.
NK/T-cell lymphoma is angiocentric and necrotic with CD56+, cytotoxic granule (granzyme B) positive cells and EBER positivity, which are absent here.
